gitCommit.body:
The Premium Curve is a registered trade mark — ™ → ® everywhere (#438)

* feat: The Premium Curve is a registered trade mark — ™ → ® everywhere

IPOS No. 40202613461T, registered from 25 May 2026, Class 14
(gold/silver bullion + bullion coins), certificate dated 2026-10-01.
Operator chose ® on every surface that carried ™.

- 15 web + server-authored SDUI placements, /api/coa/verify disclosure,
  newsletter labels + translator glossary, App Store descriptions,
  bundled cold-install SDUI JSONs
- Registration sentence added to all three trademark notices (web
  footer, web menu, native RegulatoryText.swift)
- Persona v1.2 -> v1.3 (it told agents ® was not ours); brand-voice doc
- Guard flipped: requires ®, forbids ™ next to the mark, pins the
  notice on all three surfaces (mutation-checked)

iOS: server specs reach installed apps on next fetch; bundled JSONs,
RegulatoryText.swift and store copy ride iOS 1.0.8. SDUI §170.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KARf7qdNQiDa2ZV4n92zgE

* feat: registration notice on About + Terms

The About regulatory disclaimer and Terms §IP carried the third-party
trademark list but not our own mark. Both are server-driven on iOS, so
no build. terms.md last_updated -> 2026-10-01 (new consent version for
new signups only; first-sign-in-wins means no re-consent).
